text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around campus……

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Here's your chance! Take the shot!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All right, leave it to me! I'll make sure 
to look super cool out there.

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kgh...!? No way!! I'll block it no matter 
what!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Gotta focus... right here!

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No way!? Another... slam dunk... !?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Alright! Ehehe, how do you like that!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No way...! That's insane! That makes five 
dunks in a row now, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable athleticism...! Is her core 
control just that extraordinary, or is 
there a secret to the shot itself...!?
choice_data_list:
Is there some kind of secret behind that 
dunk just now?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the secret? In that case, it must be 
thanks to that――

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's "Astonishing! Top 100 Godly Plays"! I 
just happened to catch it on TV yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ........Huh? T-Television...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, god-tier plays from athletes! They 
were all packed with so much intensity~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
There were basketball players too! 
Whenever someone threw down a dunk, the 
whole crowd went wild with cheers!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted to try copying it too! How to 
use my knees, the timing of the jump—I 
tried testing it all out, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: And then, I totally did it! Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
S-So your secret was just... watching 
their movements, that's all!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Once you get moving, you'll grasp the 
feeling in no time!
choice_data_list: Is it the same for other sports?
Is it the same for other sports?
Your athletic sense is truly genius……!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Once you get moving, you'll grasp the 
feeling in no time!
choice_data_list: Is it the same for other sports?
Is it the same for other sports?
Your athletic sense is truly genius……!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yep! I can handle pretty much any sport!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then how about we try a soccer shoot? 
You know, the kind where you spin around 
mid-air!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If we can, let's all cheer together!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, oh, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've always been good at sports 
since I was little. People used to praise 
me a lot, saying how amazing I was.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's why I believe in myself. I know I 
can pull off any superstar play out there!
